notes.title: 100 Worlds - Escape Room Game is Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We're happy to announce that our new 100 Worlds - Escape Room Game is now live! 

The goal of the game is to help Mya get out of the magic book by solving interesting and thought-provoking puzzles. 

If you enjoyed our 100 Doors games, we're pretty sure you'll like this one too! 

[b]You can get it for a 10% lower price while it's on a discount!
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491150/100_Worlds__Escape_Room_Game/

notes.title: Our New Game 100 Doors: Escape from Work is Live Now!
notes.content:
Hi 100 Doors enthusiasts!

We're happy to announce that our new game 100 Doors: Escape from Work is out! 🎉

If you enjoyed playing 100 Doors Game - Escape from School, you'll surely like this new game too! It has many challenging puzzles that will put your logical abilities to the test. 🔍

Offices in the game are inspired by the real life Google offices! 🏢

We hope you'll give it a chance! If you do, feel welcome to leave us a review and tell us your thoughts. 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684530/100_Doors_Escape_from_Work/

notes.title: Achievement & Translation Update
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. As we're constantly working on improving the game, this time we decided to focus on achievements, translation and some controls. Here's what we came up with:

[list]
[*] Now with a full set of Steam achievements
[*] Improved keyboard controls
[*] Serbian and Slovak translation added
[*] Overall game experience improved to be more intuitive and straight forward
[/list]

We love hearing from you, so please send all your feedback to support@peaksel.email .
